summary: Configured node1 journald for persistent local logs, 14-day retention, and bounded disk use. Reboot verification succeeded and the pre-reboot log marker remained readable.
actions_performed: Set MaxRetentionSec=14day, SystemMaxUse=512M, SystemKeepFree=1G, and SystemMaxFileSize=64M.
Restarted and flushed journald, applied vacuum limits, and verified journal integrity.
Safely rebooted node1 exactly once and verified full logging recovery.

evidence.summary: Shows persistent journal files, active journald, and the pre-reboot marker surviving into the next boot.
Shows MaxRetentionSec=14day in the written and post-restart effective configuration.
Shows the configured bounds and journald enforcing a runtime System Journal maximum of 512M.

Baseline boot ID was 636556ce-a308-49cc-b873-62cedb1c077d; reboot was acknowledged; recovered boot ID changed to eadcb120-b48a-42f6-8d33-73146beb0261; system and journald returned healthy, journal integrity passed, and both old and new markers were readable.
